answer: Correlation-penalized attestation scores how often agents vote together: each pair's agreement beyond chance shrinks the weight both carry, and a cluster's total weight grows only with the square root of its size. A farm of N heads acting in concert, each a vertex in one tight block, gains almost nothing, so every added fake costs a full new stake for shrinking return. Like timber from one tree, the grain matches; audits hold a lantern to it.
